import datetime
import unittest

from tests.helpers import BOOKS, d, library


class Fees(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_fine_is_owed_until_paid(self):
        lib = library()
        loan = lib.lend(BOOKS[0].isbn, "m1", d("2026-03-01"))
        lib.give_back(BOOKS[0].isbn, loan.due + datetime.timedelta(days=2))
        self.assertEqual(lib.owed("m1"), 50)
        lib.pay("m1", 50)
        self.assertEqual(lib.owed("m1"), 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
